edges.reason: transfer delegates execution to _transfer with _msgSender() and amount.
approve delegates allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move tokens.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce spender allowance.
increasealowance writes allowance through _approve.
decreaseallowance writes allowance through _approve.
CreateAFarm mints arbitrary amounts through _mint.
CreateAFarm is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
CheckAPY is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
SetStakingReward is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
ActivateProtocol is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_burnFrom calls _burn for the account balance.
_burnFrom reduces caller allowance via _approve.
transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transfer calls randomly() to decide the moon flag of non-whitelisted recipients.
randomly() computes a keccak256-based pseudo-random value into the unsafe randomness sink.
msg.sender becomes creator and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
onlyOwner authorizes based on the untrusted _msgSender() compared to _owner/_ownr.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness seed in randomly().
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy in randomly(), creating timestamp dependency.
now is fed directly into the keccak256 randomness computation.
msg.sender is fed directly into the keccak256 randomness computation.
saturn counter is fed into the keccak256 randomness seed.
saturn is read and incremented inside randomly().
_transfer mutates the saturn counter indirectly through randomly().
_transfer reads and writes mars flags that gate who may transfer.
_transfer reads and writes moon flags that gate and propagate transfer ability.
_transfer reads and writes earth flags used to block flagged senders.
_transfer enforces require(amount < uranus) as the transfer-size cap.
_transfer toggles and branches on the neptune one-shot flag.
_transfer special-cases the creator address for gating and flag updates.
_transfer consults and sets the ceres global flag to block flagged senders.
_transfer debits and credits _balances using SafeMath sub/add.
_transfer can hit an unconditional require(false) that permanently blocks an address.
_mint increases _totalSupply without any upper bound.
_mint credits _balances[account] with newly created tokens.
CreateAFarm exposes the unlimited owner minting capability.
owner can arbitrarily overwrite the uranus transfer cap.
owner sets uranus to chTx/2400 during protocol activation.
owner enables the ceres blocking flag during activation.
owner can set mars[spender] to whitelist or de-whitelist any address.
owner can set moon[spender] for any address.
owner can set earth[spender] for any address.
owner can toggle the global ceres flag via CheckAPY.
_approve overrides the stored allowance with 1443 when moon[owner] is true.
_approve sets mars[spender]=true on the first creator approval.
_approve consumes the pluto one-shot backdoor flag.
_approve special-cases the creator address for the pluto backdoor.
_approve writes the resulting value into _allowances.
constructor stores msg.sender into creator.
constructor assigns the entire initial supply to _balances[msg.sender].
constructor sets the initial _totalSupply.
constructor marks the deployer as mars=true.
constructor sets neptune=true.
constructor sets pluto=true.
constructor sets ceres=false.
amount parameter flows into _transfer balance math and threshold checks.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer flag updates and balance credit.
sender parameter flows into _transfer gating and balance debit.
spender parameter flows into approve.
spender parameter flows into _approve allowance storage.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into _transferOwnership owner assignment.
screen local holds the modulo result returned by randomly().
tok local holds the possibly moon-overridden allowance stored by _approve.

normalization_plan.reason: The transient amount parameter only exists to feed _transfer; merge it into the _transfer core node.
The transient recipient parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer; merge it into _transfer.
The transient sender parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer; merge it into _transfer.
The spender parameter ultimately resolves into the _approve allowance write, so merge it into _approve.
The newOwner parameter is consumed by the _transferOwnership owner assignment, so merge it there.
The screen local is an intermediate randomness value wholly contained in randomly(); merge it into randomly.
The tok local is an intermediate allowance value wholly contained in _approve; merge it into _approve.
